description: Send the Volanea team a one-line note that a capability this server has no tool for was needed. Records only the capability text; it changes nothing in the project, reads no project data, and does not create the missing capability.

capability.description: The missing capability in one line, phrased as the operation you wanted — e.g. "check whether an address is suppressed" or "list scheduled sends".

name: volanea_report_missing_tool

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

message.description: Confirmation. Nothing about the project changed.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
